headings.usage: Hero titles, section headers, prominent numbers.

editorial_accent.usage: Use sparingly for large quotes, stylized ampersands, or overarching labels.

layouts.destinations_grid: The Bento/Tetris grid. md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Mix tall, wide, and square cards.
layouts.experiences_layout: Overlapping images with large typography behind/in front of the images.
layouts.spacing: Generous. Use py-24 or py-32 for section padding.

motion.hero: Cinematic. Slow pan/zoom on images. Text enters via clip reveal or subtle slide-up stagger. NO bouncing.
motion.particles: Use TSParticles or framer-motion for snow (Kashmir), golden dust (Rajasthan), shimmering light (Amritsar).
motion.interactions: Hover scale (1.02) and subtle shadow increase. Image hover = slow 1.05 scale inside overflow-hidden container.
motion.price_counter: Use framer-motion useSpring/animate to animate from ₹39,999 to ₹29,999.

visual_enhancers.torn_paper: Create a premium travel magazine vibe. Wrap an image in a div, apply a jagged SVG mask-image (or clip-path), add drop-shadow and slight rotation.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used for sticky nav and modal overlays. bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-gray-100. NEVER fully transparent.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay across the site to give it a cinematic film feel.

components.utility_bar: Very slim at the top. Background deep ocean blue (#0A2540). Text white. Text size text-xs. Link 'Prime HomeEase' (primehomeease.com, new tab), +91 8699913245, contact@primejourneyindia.com, Language (EN/HI/PA).
components.navbar: Sticky at top, Z-50. White glassmorphism (bg-white/90 backdrop-blur). Links: Destinations, Holidays, Experiences, Packages, Customize, About. Right: Login + Book Now.
components.founders: Use Shadcn Avatar with initials (M, D, A, R) for Master, Dheeraj, Abhishek, Ramesh.

accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute.
accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images has sufficient contrast using background overlays (e.g., bg-black/40) or text shadows.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a standard React (.js) frontend. DO NOT use TypeScript (.tsx).
Use Shadcn UI for forms, inputs, modals, tabs, avatars.
Implement Framer Motion for scroll reveals, staggering list items, and animating the price counter.
Do NOT use placeholder text or external placeholder image URLs. Use the provided image URLs or Shadcn Avatar fallbacks.
Ensure 'data-testid' is present on all interactive elements.
Make sure the navbar glassmorphism has a background color (e.g. bg-white/80), NOT fully transparent.
Torn paper effect must be achieved using CSS (mask-image with jagged SVG path or clip-path) layered over/under text.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific transitions.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
